items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: they had everybody that was still alive from the Goldkette band involved... Spiegle Willcox... is still alive

ctx.x: He was an interesting character I guess, from what I read.

Bix? Well one of the interesting things about that series of concerts was that they had everybody that was still alive from the Goldkette band involved in that concert at one time or another, so while I never met Bix, I hung out with Joe Venuti, I hung out with Doc Ryker who was the lead alto saxophone, Chauncey Morehouse the drummer was still alive, Spiegle Willcox, who may be here tomorrow, is still alive living in Cincinnatus, New York. You ought to go over and see him.
My goodness, thanks for that information.
